programs.desc: An unfiltered look at police departments in action; a car crash in Indiana, a foot chase in Florida; a stolen car in Oklahoma.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When a suspect panics and runs, the dog smells it instantly; one bad decision leads to a very fast ending. K-9 Jax chases after a suspect accused of stealing a car; K-9 Bane helps bring a multi-state manhunt for one of Philadelphia's most wanted to a shocking end; after a funeral procession, K9 Timmy ends a tense standoff and K9 Jedi makes his handler into the happiest cop in the force.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Fresh out of the academy, rookie K9 Carrier gets the call, but can he score his first apprehension?; in a pounding downpour, K9 Flash stays locked on the scent, tracking a suspect who bolted even after being tasered.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When high-speed chases end in foot pursuits, the K9 takes over where engines can't; on Valentine's Day, K9 Igo shuts down a tense standoff before it explodes; K9 Duder teams up with a fellow K9 unit in a takedown that leaves a suspect nowhere to run; K9 Chase proves his name isn't just for show; and K9 Apollo sniffs out someone buried deep in thick brush within seconds.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: In Texas, everything's bigger, except the hiding spots, and K9 Enzo proves it, locking onto a suspect wedged beneath a house; on the graveyard shift, rookie K9 Deebo steps up and shows he's the real deal; in Florida, officers shut down traffic for a high-stakes helicopter landing, rushing K9 Huk to an emergency hospital; elsewhere, K9 Diesel plunges headfirst into dark waters in pursuit of a suspect and K9 Vinnie is deployed to take down a dangerous suspect hurling Molotov cocktails.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Along with FBI and Department of Correction agents, K-9 Eddie tracks down a suspect with an active warrant. Meanwhile, K-9 Jax hits the ground running, searching for a suspect accused of stealing a pickup truck. K-9 Dundee deploys in pursuit of a suspect who crashed a van straight into a fitness center, causing major damage. And despite a high-tech surveillance system in place, K-9 Koda is called in to do what technology can't: follow the scent and find the suspect.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When officers issue that final K-9 warning, it's the last chance to back down - surrender or face the dog. K-9 Scout collides head-on with an armed suspect who refuses to back down and K-9 Vlad, "The Impaler," squares up with a defiant driver who won't follow commands. In the dead of night, K-9 Edge tracks down and takes down two fleeing suspected thieves and K-9 ZAM methodically tears through a vehicle search, uncovering a laundry list of charges.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When fleeing suspects put the public at risk, K9 teams race the clock to shut it down; K9 Haywire rolls in with SWAT, in search of a hit-and-run suspect who vanishes into a residential area; in a tense nighttime manhunt, K9s Ax and Endo step into the line of fire to shield their handlers; K9 Rico pulls double duty when a routine traffic stop erupts into chaos; under a blazing sun, K9 King battles the heat to stay on scent and close the gap.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: K9 Tipster comes face-to-face with a familiar face, a repeat offender who remembers their last encounter all too well; K9 Murphy, a battle-tested German Shepherd with over a hundred deployments under his collar, is called in when a crash scene turns into a manhunt; meanwhile, K9 Murph tears into action, tracking down a suspect whose joyride breaks one too many laws; and K9 Guapo, arguably the most handsome dog on the force, proves he's more than just good looks.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: From tangled brush to pitch-black streets, these K9s sniff out danger with precision; after a tense pursuit, K9 Eddie corners a suspect hiding deep in a ravine; across the country, K9 Streeter makes a heart-stopping leap; K9 Riggs corners a double murder suspect; K9 Diesel kicks off his late-night shift by chasing down a hit-and-run perp.
